findings.title: routeRegisteredVertex gossipTopicFor save/restore is not re-entrant
findings.evidence: tests/fixtures/phase-6a-v3/creator-adoption-contract.ts:1141-1167 captures networkNode.gossipTopicFor into a local and restores it in finally; two concurrent invocations would capture each other's override and leave one synthetic classifier installed permanently after both return.
findings.impact: Latent fixture-only hazard. All current call sites are strictly sequential (established-peer routing and contract routeVertex calls await each route), and a poisoned classifier would surface as D110C_FIXTURE_REGISTERED_VERTEX_ADMISSION_TIMEOUT rather than a silent pass, as the retained early-restore diagnostic demonstrates.
findings.required_action: Document the sequential-only contract on routeRegisteredVertex, or guard the override with a depth counter/serialization before any future concurrent use.
